_why: Current renderer audit, not historical design rounds. All failures are synthetic workbench-only method overrides; no real provider, file, report, installation or session is touched. Fresh page per shot resets overrides. Expectations require visible failure text, not merely an open dialog. Report rejection shots deliberately remain MISSED if the renderer has no visible error handling; do not weaken their expectations to pass. Paused is currently labelled Download interrupted by the renderer.

pre.eval: if(new URLSearchParams(location.search).get('mode')!=='workbench'||!new URLSearchParams(location.search).has('child')) throw new Error('Mock injection requires child workbench'); /* WHY: mock namespaces use get-only catch-all proxies, so assigning methods directly is ignored. Wrap each namespace with a local override map instead. */ for(const ns of ['chatgpt','providers','models','permissions','dev']){const original=window.claude[ns], overrides={};window.claude[ns]=new Proxy(original,{get:(target,key)=>Object.hasOwn(overrides,key)?overrides[key]:Reflect.get(target,key),set:(_target,key,value)=>{overrides[key]=value;return true;}});} window.auditVisible=(text)=>[...document.querySelectorAll('[role=dialog] *')].some(e=>e.textContent.trim()===text&&e.checkVisibility({checkOpacity:true,checkVisibilityCSS:true})&&(()=>{const r=e.getBoundingClientRect();return r.width>0&&r.height>0&&r.top>=0&&r.bottom<=innerHeight})()); window.auditScroll=(text)=>{const e=[...document.querySelectorAll('[role=dialog] *')].find(e=>e.textContent.trim()===text);if(!e)throw new Error('Missing audit target: '+text);e.scrollIntoView({block:'center'});};
